LanguageData.JoyRescue.Taxonomy.Enable: Use the common recreation fix set (restart required)
LanguageData.JoyRescue.Taxonomy.Tooltip: Applies exact, checked building activity rules when RimWorld starts. Manual assignments take priority. Changed or shared activities are skipped and reported. Keeps drivers, timings and rewards. Turning this off restores original assignments after restart; retained types and transferred tolerance are not deleted. Reset also keeps existing type identities once this preset has been used. Save settings before restarting.
LanguageData.JoyRescue.Taxonomy.Summary: Common fixes this session: {0} applied, {1} skipped (details in log report).
LanguageData.JoyRescue.Taxonomy.Reset: Reset activity settings and turn off the common fix set? Existing recreation types and their order will be retained for save compatibility. Restart to restore original assignments.
